agent_explanation: Single circle falls under gravity and bounces on arena floor (y=0.5 contact). Energy is conserved (~57.76 J) through step 62, then at step 63 the contact resolves with outgoing speed 12.34 exceeding incoming 10.27 despite e=0.9 (which should give ~9.2 rebound), injecting ~23 J with controller_work=0. Likely cause is faulty floor restitution/positional-correction that adds energy instead of dissipating e^2 fraction.
